sql:
SELECT sales_channel,
COUNT(*) AS orders,
SUM(charged_amount) AS gmv,
AVG(charged_amount) AS aov,
AVG(mrp) AS avg_mrp,
ROUND(100.0 * (1 - AVG(charged_amount) / NULLIF(AVG(mrp), 0)), 1) AS discount_pct
FROM zs_observe.increff_sales
WHERE is_active = true AND order_status = 'COMPLETED' AND transaction_type = 'SALES'
GROUP BY sales_channel ORDER BY gmv DESC;

SELECT brand, sales_channel,
COUNT(*) AS orders,
SUM(charged_amount) AS gmv
FROM zs_observe.increff_sales
WHERE is_active = true AND order_status = 'COMPLETED' AND transaction_type = 'SALES'
GROUP BY brand, sales_channel
ORDER BY gmv DESC;

display_name: 9.3 Return Rate by Channel (Mensa Brands Only)
source_section: 9.3 Return Rate by Channel (Mensa Brands Only)
sql:
SELECT s.sales_channel,
COUNT(DISTINCT s.order_id) AS dispatched,
COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.transaction_type = 'customer_return' THEN r.order_id END) AS cust_returns,
COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.transaction_type = 'return_to_origin' THEN r.order_id END) AS rto,
ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.transaction_type = 'customer_return' THEN r.order_id END)
/ NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT s.order_id), 0), 2) AS return_rate_pct,
ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.transaction_type = 'return_to_origin' THEN r.order_id END)
/ NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT s.order_id), 0), 2) AS rto_rate_pct
FROM zs_observe.increff_sales s
LEFT JOIN zs_observe.increff_returns r
ON s.order_id = r.order_id AND r.is_active = true
AND r.brand IN ('Dennis Lingo','High Star','Ishin','Hubberholme','Botanic Hearth',
'Anubhutee','BeyBee','Lilpicks','Folkulture','PrettyKrafts','Prettykrafts',
'Estalon','Urbanfix')
WHERE s.is_active = true AND s.order_status = 'COMPLETED'
GROUP BY s.sales_channel ORDER BY dispatched DESC;

SELECT sales_channel,
COUNT(*) AS total_orders,
COUNT_IF(description = 'COD') AS cod_orders,
ROUND(100.0 * COUNT_IF(description = 'COD') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS cod_pct,
SUM(charged_amount) AS gmv
FROM zs_observe.increff_sales
WHERE is_active = true AND order_status = 'COMPLETED'
GROUP BY sales_channel ORDER BY cod_pct DESC;
-- High COD % → Higher RTO risk (undelivered, refused orders)

SELECT source_gst_id, source_city,
COUNT(*) AS orders_dispatched,
SUM(charged_amount) AS gmv,
COUNT(DISTINCT sku_id) AS distinct_skus,
COUNT(DISTINCT brand) AS brands,
COUNT(DISTINCT sales_channel) AS channels
FROM zs_observe.increff_sales
WHERE is_active = true AND order_status = 'COMPLETED'
GROUP BY source_gst_id, source_city ORDER BY orders_dispatched DESC;

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST(created_date AS DATE)) AS month,
COUNT(*) AS orders_dispatched,
SUM(charged_amount) AS gmv,
COUNT_IF(description = 'COD') AS cod_orders,
COUNT_IF(description = 'NCOD') AS prepaid_orders
FROM zs_observe.increff_sales
WHERE is_active = true AND order_status = 'COMPLETED' AND transaction_type = 'SALES'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

-- increff_sales: completed sales only
WHERE is_active = true
AND order_status = 'COMPLETED'
AND transaction_type = 'SALES'
-- increff_returns: Mensa brands only
WHERE is_active = true
AND brand IN ('Dennis Lingo','High Star','Ishin','Hubberholme','Botanic Hearth',
'Anubhutee','BeyBee','Lilpicks','Folkulture','PrettyKrafts','Prettykrafts',
'Estalon','Urbanfix')
-- Both tables
AND group_level_id = 22

display_name: 8.1 Return Volume by Channel and Type
source_section: 8.1 Return Volume by Channel and Type
sql:
SELECT sales_channel, transaction_type,
COUNT(*) AS returns,
COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS distinct_orders,
SUM(charged_amount) AS return_value,
AVG(charged_amount) AS avg_return_value
FROM zs_observe.increff_returns
WHERE is_active = true
GROUP BY sales_channel, transaction_type
ORDER BY returns DESC;

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', created_date) AS month,
COUNT(*) AS returns,
COUNT_IF(transaction_type = 'customer_return') AS customer_returns,
COUNT_IF(transaction_type = 'return_to_origin') AS rto,
SUM(charged_amount) AS return_value
FROM zs_observe.increff_returns
WHERE is_active = true
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT brand, sales_channel,
COUNT_IF(return_order_qc_status = 'PASS') AS qc_pass,
COUNT_IF(return_order_qc_status = 'FAIL') AS qc_fail,
COUNT(*) AS total_returns,
ROUND(100.0 * COUNT_IF(return_order_qc_status = 'FAIL')
/ NULLIF(COUNT_IF(return_order_qc_status IS NOT NULL), 0), 1) AS fail_rate_pct
FROM zs_observe.increff_returns
WHERE is_active = true
AND return_order_qc_status IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY brand, sales_channel ORDER BY total_returns DESC;

SELECT reason_for_return,
COUNT(*) AS returns,
SUM(charged_amount) AS total_value,
AVG(charged_amount) AS avg_value,
ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 1) AS pct_of_returns
FROM zs_observe.increff_returns
WHERE is_active = true AND reason_for_return IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY reason_for_return ORDER BY returns DESC;

SELECT s.sales_channel,
COUNT(DISTINCT s.order_id) AS sold_orders,
COUNT(DISTINCT r.order_id) AS returned_orders,
ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT r.order_id)
/ NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT s.order_id), 0), 2) AS return_rate_pct
FROM zs_observe.increff_sales s
LEFT JOIN zs_observe.increff_returns r
ON s.order_id = r.order_id AND r.is_active = true
WHERE s.is_active = true AND s.order_status = 'COMPLETED'
GROUP BY s.sales_channel ORDER BY sold_orders DESC;

display_name: 8.6 Enrich Returns with SKU from Sales
source_section: 8.6 Enrich Returns with SKU from Sales
sql:
SELECT r.order_id, r.brand, r.sales_channel,
r.charged_amount AS return_value,
r.transaction_type,
r.return_order_qc_status,
s.sku_id, s.size, s.hsn,
s.charged_amount AS original_sale_value,
s.description AS payment_type
FROM zs_observe.increff_returns r
LEFT JOIN zs_observe.increff_sales s
ON r.order_id = s.order_id AND s.is_active = true
WHERE r.is_active = true
AND r.sales_channel = 'SHOPIFY_DL';

SELECT
DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST(created_date AS DATE)) AS month,
sales_channel,
COUNT(*) AS orders,
SUM(charged_amount) AS gmv
FROM zs_observe.increff_sales
WHERE is_active = true
AND order_status = 'COMPLETED'
AND transaction_type = 'SALES'
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 3 DESC;

SELECT brand,
COUNT(*) AS shipped_orders,
COUNT(DISTINCT sku_id) AS distinct_skus,
SUM(charged_amount) AS gmv,
AVG(charged_amount) AS aov,
AVG(mrp) AS avg_mrp,
ROUND(100.0 * (1 - AVG(charged_amount) / NULLIF(AVG(mrp), 0)), 1) AS avg_discount_pct
FROM zs_observe.increff_sales
WHERE is_active = true AND order_status = 'COMPLETED' AND transaction_type = 'SALES'
GROUP BY brand ORDER BY gmv DESC;

display_name: 7.3 COD vs Prepaid Mix by Channel
source_section: 7.3 COD vs Prepaid Mix by Channel
sql:
SELECT sales_channel,
COUNT(*) AS total,
COUNT_IF(description = 'COD') AS cod,
COUNT_IF(description = 'NCOD') AS prepaid,
ROUND(100.0 * COUNT_IF(description = 'COD') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS cod_pct
FROM zs_observe.increff_sales
WHERE is_active = true AND order_status = 'COMPLETED'
GROUP BY sales_channel ORDER BY total DESC;

SELECT source_gst_id, source_city,
COUNT(*) AS dispatched_orders,
SUM(charged_amount) AS gmv,
array_join(array_agg(DISTINCT sales_channel ORDER BY sales_channel), ' | ') AS channels
FROM zs_observe.increff_sales
WHERE is_active = true AND order_status = 'COMPLETED'
GROUP BY source_gst_id, source_city ORDER BY dispatched_orders DESC;

SELECT sku_id, brand, description AS payment_type,
COUNT(*) AS orders,
SUM(charged_amount) AS revenue,
AVG(charged_amount) AS avg_price,
AVG(mrp) AS avg_mrp
FROM zs_observe.increff_sales
WHERE is_active = true AND order_status = 'COMPLETED' AND transaction_type = 'SALES'
GROUP BY sku_id, brand, description
ORDER BY orders DESC LIMIT 30;

SELECT
CASE
WHEN LOWER(TRIM(fulfilment_channel)) LIKE '%delhivery%' THEN 'Delhivery'
WHEN LOWER(TRIM(fulfilment_channel)) LIKE '%shadowfax%' THEN 'Shadowfax'
WHEN LOWER(TRIM(fulfilment_channel)) LIKE '%ekart%' OR LOWER(TRIM(fulfilment_channel)) LIKE '%ek_%' THEN 'Ekart'
WHEN LOWER(TRIM(fulfilment_channel)) LIKE '%xpressbees%' OR LOWER(TRIM(fulfilment_channel)) LIKE '%xbees%' THEN 'XpressBees'
WHEN LOWER(TRIM(fulfilment_channel)) LIKE '%bluedart%' THEN 'BlueDart'
WHEN LOWER(TRIM(fulfilment_channel)) LIKE '%ecomexpress%' OR LOWER(TRIM(fulfilment_channel)) LIKE '%ecx%' THEN 'EcomExpress'
WHEN LOWER(TRIM(fulfilment_channel)) LIKE '%flipkart%' THEN 'Flipkart Logistics'
WHEN LOWER(TRIM(fulfilment_channel)) LIKE '%myntra%' THEN 'Myntra Logistics'
ELSE 'Other'
END AS courier_family,
COUNT(*) AS shipments,
SUM(charged_amount) AS gmv
FROM zs_observe.increff_sales
WHERE is_active = true AND order_status = 'COMPLETED'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY shipments DESC;
